scene_translation: The old man narrowed his eyes and was silent for a moment. '…From the old woman, is it,' he murmured, reaching his hand under the counter. 'I didn't think that woman was still telling people,' he said. He placed an old key on the counter and said quietly, 'Take this. But… be careful.'
grammar_note: 【とは思わなかった】'I didn't think that…' — とは adds a nuance of surprise or disbelief. Note the old man's speech style: rough, clipped sentences with だ/ぞ forms and no politeness markers — very different from a polite shopkeeper who would say 思いませんでした.

vocab.meaning: to be careful, to watch out

feedback: Great effort — the meaning came through clearly! The natural phrasing would be 「おばあさんから聞きました」— when attaching です to a verb, use the ます-form (聞きました) rather than the dictionary form (聞いた). So: 聞いたです → 聞きました.
